record.one_liner: Work management platform for tasks, projects and teams, with a REST API and an official MCP server.
record.auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow for apps acting on behalf of users. Personal access tokens (PAT) generated in the developer console for personal or single-workspace use. The MCP server uses OAuth only.
record.access_notes: PAT generation and OAuth app creation are in the developer console. The fetched pages do not state a plan requirement; the claim that the API is free rests on an Asana API Terms search snippet that was not opened, so confidence is medium.
record.api_notes: Breadth not verified: only the REST reference landing page was fetched, which does not list objects or endpoints.
record.blocker_notes: Credentials are self-serve. Whether production use of a public OAuth app needs Asana review was not checked.

evidence.quote: Asana supports the authorization code grant flow
A personal access token (PAT) contains your security credentials for the Asana platform.
You can generate a personal access token from the Asana developer console.
The Asana API is a RESTful interface with predictable resource-oriented URLs
The Asana V2 MCP server is generally available and uses OAuth for authorization.
You'll pre-register your MCP app in the developer console, where you can create both standard API apps and MCP apps.
